name: mazel
//: One Worker per person, on their own Cloudflare account. Deploy to Cloudflare provisions the mailbox and sets the pulse from this file; nothing here needs editing, and nothing personal lives in it. Your handle and your card are written in your first conversation with your own AI, not here.
//guard: bin/deploy-guard.mjs stops a wrangler deploy run from a clone: this file has no KV id, so a deploy from here would bind a new empty mailbox and strand the old one. Deploy to Cloudflare runs in CI, where the guard passes. Updates go through create-mazel.
//store: The portal's state lives in a Durable Object on the SQLite backend, which runs on the free plan. KV stays bound: the published public card lives there, and a portal that predates the object still reads and writes KV until it is migrated.
